title: Zero-section integration transpose along the actual chart differential
statement:
Fix the finite purity setting P [def-pur-conventions], an affine finite-type k-scheme Y, a separated finite-type smooth h:U→Y of pure dimension d≥0, and an etale Y-map e:U→A^d_Y. U may be non-affine or empty. Use the canonical source, actual Rees differential-normal map and integration beta of [def-pur-chart-affine-comparison-data], and the site comparisons of [def-pur-section-pullback-site-comparisons]. For every normalized compact-support presentation N (and normalized Tate transport t in the transpose equation), the following derived-category equation holds, with its full formal signature:

theorem chart_integration_adjoints (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u}) {U Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine Y]
    (d : ℕ) (h : U ⟶ Y) [IsSeparated h] [LocallyOfFiniteType h] [QuasiCompact h]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d h]
    (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY]
    (e : U ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) Y) [Etale e]
    (w : e ≫ (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) Y ↘ Y) = h)
    (N : Etale.EtaleCompactSupportNormalization P.Coefficient)
    (t : Etale.OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
      P.diagonalExponent_annihilates) :
  let p := AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) Y ↘ Y
  letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension d p := by
    simpa using AffineSpace.smoothOfRelativeDimension_over (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) Y
  letI := P.noetherian (h ≫ aY)
  (beta P d h aY N).inv ≫ (normal P d h aY e w).hom =
      (tate P d aY e t).inv ≫
        (ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) e).leftDerivedFunctor.map
          (beta P d p aY N).inv

proof.text:
the graded conormal pullback sends [a] tensor y to [e*a y]. The canonical
normal models therefore identify the displayed normalMap with the linear pullback
of the affine diagonal normal bundle, preserving projections and augmentations.
Vector-bundle purity supplies the equation E e*gamma_A = gamma_U tau for the
actual integration transpose gamma. Pull this equation along the zero section and
use normalMap z_U = z_A e. The inverse exceptional exchange restricted to zero is
exactly normal, by smooth base-change and normalized etale locality. The inverse
of beta is gamma transported through the canonical normal model. The resulting
equation is beta_U inverse followed by normal = inverse Tate followed by
e*beta_A inverse. The ordinary/pro-etale integration-site comparison preserves
the trace, its transpose, and the pullback constraints, so it gives these specified
maps. Linear trace invariance makes the calculation independent of frames.
In rank zero use the identity-adjunction trace; on an empty source the morphisms
are unique. No DNC map or choice of a coefficient-line orientation is used.

lean.statement: theorem chart_integration_adjoints (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u}) {U Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine Y] (d : ℕ) (h : U ⟶ Y) [IsSeparated h] [LocallyOfFiniteType h] [QuasiCompact h] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d h] (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY] (e : U ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) Y) [Etale e] (w : e ≫ (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) Y ↘ Y) = h) (N : Etale.EtaleCompactSupportNormalization P.Coefficient) (t : Etale.OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent P.diagonalExponent_annihilates) : let p := AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) Y ↘ Y letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension d p := by simpa using AffineSpace.smoothOfRelativeDimension_over (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) Y letI := P.noetherian (h ≫ aY) (beta P d h aY N).inv ≫ (normal P d h aY e w).hom = (tate P d aY e t).inv ≫ (ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) e).leftDerivedFunctor.map (beta P d p aY N).inv
